findings.description: FIND — `_check_gamma_gate` has inverted pass/fail semantics. findings.description: FIND: Regex `_VERDICT_RE` line `r'^\s*(?:[*]{0,2}[-*]?\s*)?(CONFIRM|CHALLENGE|EXTEND|MERGE|REOPEN)\s+(C\d{4,})'` incorrectly uses `C\d{4,}` which requires *at least* 4 digits. Evidence: Python regex `\d{4,}` matches 4+ digits; `C0001` has exactly 4 digits, so it matches, but `C001` (3 digits) would not. However, the comment says "supports IDs beyond 9999", which requires `{4,}`. This is contradictory: either we want exactly 4 digits (fixed width) or variable width. The current generation uses exactly 4 digits, so the regex should be `C\d{4}` (or `C\d{4,}` if we want to support >4 digits but still allow 4). The latter is okay, but the comment is misleading.

    r'(?:\s*[*]{0,2}\s*[|<\-\u2014\u2013\u2190]+\s*(.*))?',
